header-height.$description: Height of the sticky site header. Used by the header and by scroll-padding.

comfortable.$description: Recommended hit area on touch devices. Controls may look smaller if they extend their hit area under `@media (pointer: coarse)`.

xs.$description: Icon in extra small elements such as small badges (12px).

sm.$description: Icon in small controls, menu items and inline with text (16px).

md.$description: Default icon, and icons in large buttons (20px).

xl.$description: Icon in empty states and featured elements (32px).

icon.$description: Gap between an icon and its label, matched to the icon size. Never smaller than the text it sits next to.

container.$description: Max content widths for page layouts.

xs.$description: Compact content width for controls and narrow examples.

dialog.$description: Maximum widths for centered dialogs. The medium width is the compact default for focused tasks.

xs.$description: Extra-compact dialogs for short confirmations and single-field tasks.

md.$description: Default width for focused dialog tasks.

lg.$description: Roomier width for forms, tables and detailed content.

xl.$description: Extra-roomy width for complex forms, tables and detailed content.

md.$description: Maximum height for dialogs before their body scrolls.

menu.$description: Optional fixed widths for menu popups. Auto remains content-sized.

breakpoint.$description: Viewport widths where the layout changes. Mobile first: write `@media (min-width: ...)` with one of these values. CSS cannot read variables inside a media query, so copy the value.

md.$description: 768px. Tablets and up: the header shows the full nav.

lg.$description: 1024px. Laptops and up: the docs sidebar appears.
